readings.title: The Petition of Zelophehad's Daughters
readings.subtitle: A Plea for Generational Continuity
readings.text: [Numbers 27:1] Then came the daughters of Tselophḥaḏ, son of Ḥěpher, son of Gil‛aḏ, son of Maḵir, son of Menashsheh, from the clans of Menashsheh, son of Yosěph. And these were the names of his daughters: Maḥlah, No‛ah, and Ḥoḡlah, and Milkah, and Tirtsah. [2] And they stood before Mosheh, and before El‛azar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation, by the doorway of the Tent of Appointment, saying, [3] “Our father died in the wilderness, yet he was not in the company of those who were met together against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in company with Qoraḥ, but he died in his own sin. And he had no sons. [4] “Why should the name of our father be removed from among his clan because he had no son? Give us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

readings.title: The Righteous Verdict on Succession
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH's Decree for Familial Preservation
readings.text: [Numbers 27:5] Mosheh then brought <dn>את</dn> their case before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [6] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [7] <dq>“The daughters of Tselophḥaḏ speak what is right. You should certainly give them a possession of inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause <dn>את</dn> the inheritance of their father to pass to them.</dq> [8] <dq>“And speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘When a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to pass to his daughter.</dq> [9] <dq>And if he has no daughter, then you shall give <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to his brothers.</dq> [10] <dq>And if he has no brothers, then you shall give <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to his father’s brothers.</dq> [11] <dq>And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, and he shall possess it.’ ” And it shall be to the children of Yisra’ěl a law of right-ruling, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh.</dq>

readings.title: The Geographic Guarantee
readings.subtitle: The Weight of Leadership and Consequence
readings.text: [Numbers 27:12] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Go up into this Mount Aḇarim, and see <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>I</dn> have given to the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq> [13] <dq>“And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people as Aharon your brother was gathered,</dq> [14] <dq>because you rebelled against <dn>My</dn> mouth in the Wilderness of Tsin, in the strife of the congregation, to set <dn>Me</dn> apart at the waters before their eyes.”</dq> These were the waters of Meriḇah, at Qaḏěsh in the Wilderness of Tsin.

readings.title: Commissioning the Successor
readings.subtitle: Joshua Appointed to Shepherd the Flock
readings.text: [Numbers 27:15] And Mosheh spoke to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, saying, [16] “Let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the <dn>Elohim</dn> of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation, [17] who goes out before them and comes in before them, who leads them out and brings them in, so that the congregation of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be not like sheep without a shepherd.” [18] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Spirit. And you shall lay <dn>את</dn> your hand on him,</dq> [19] <dq>and shall set him before El‛azar the priest and before all the congregation, and give him command before their eyes,</dq> [20] <dq>and shall put some of your esteem upon him, so that all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ěl obey him.</dq> [21] <dq>“And he is to stand before El‛azar the priest, who shall inquire before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for him by the right-ruling of the Urim. At his word they go out, and at his word they come in, both he and all the children of Yisra’ěl with him, all the congregation.”</dq> [22] And Mosheh did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded him, and took <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua and set him before El‛azar the priest and before all the congregation, [23] and laid <dn>את</dn> his hands on him and commissioned him, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded by the hand of Mosheh.

readings.title: The Tamid: Continual Functional Harmony
readings.subtitle: The Daily Ascending Offerings
readings.text: [Numbers 28:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>"Command the children of Yisra’ěl, and you shall say to them, ‘Take heed to bring <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> offering, <dn>My</dn> food for <dn>My</dn> offerings made by fire as a sweet fragrance to <dn>Me</dn>, at their appointed time.’</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two male lambs a year old, perfect ones, daily, a continual ascending offering.</dq> [4] <dq><dn>את</dn> The one lamb you prepare in the morning, and <dn>את</dn> the other lamb you prepare between the evenings,</dq> [5] <dq>with one-tenth of an ěphah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil,</dq> [6] <dq>a continual ascending offering which was offered at Mount Sinai for a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,</dq> [7] <dq>and its drink offering, one-fourth of a hin for each lamb. Pour out the drink to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> as an offering in the set-apart place.</dq> [8] <dq>And <dn>את</dn> the other lamb you prepare between the evenings. As the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you prepare it as an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Sabbath: The Seventh-Day Seal
readings.subtitle: The Weekly Rehearsal of Rest
readings.text: [Numbers 28:9] <dq>And on the Sabbath day two lambs a year old, perfect ones, and two-tenths of an ěphah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering,</dq> [10] <dq>the ascending offering for every Sabbath, besides the continual ascending offering with its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: The Renewed Moon Cycles
readings.subtitle: Observation of the Monthly Ascending Offering
readings.text: [Numbers 28:11] <dq>And on the beginnings of your new moons you bring near an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two young bulls and one ram, and seven lambs a year old, perfect ones;</dq> [12] <dq>three-tenths of an ěphah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths of an ěphah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;</dq> [13] <dq>and one-tenth of an ěphah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as an ascending offering of sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [14] <dq>And their drink offering is half a hin of wine for a bull, and one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb. This is the ascending offering for each new moon throughout the new moons of the year,</dq> [15] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is prepared, besides the continual ascending offering and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: Pesach: The Decisive Intervention
readings.subtitle: The Seven-Day Rehearsal of Unleavened Bread
readings.text: [Numbers 28:16] <dq>And in the first new moon, on the fourteenth day, is the Pěsaḥ of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,</dq> [17] <dq>and on the fifteenth day of this new moon is a festival. For seven days unleavened bread is eaten.</dq> [18] <dq>On the first day is a set-apart gathering, you do no servile work.</dq> [19] <dq>And you shall bring near an offering made by fire as an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two young bulls and one ram, and seven lambs a year old, perfect ones they are for you,</dq> [20] <dq>and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil. Prepare three-tenths of an ěphah for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram.</dq> [21] <dq>Prepare one-tenth of an ěphah for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [22] <dq>and one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.</dq> [23] <dq>Prepare these besides the ascending offering of the morning, which is for a continual ascending offering.</dq> [24] <dq>According to these you are to prepare <dn>את</dn> the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It is prepared besides the continual ascending offering and its drink offering.</dq> [25] <dq>And on the seventh day you have a set-apart gathering, you do no servile work.</dq>

readings.title: Shavuoth: The First-Fruits
readings.subtitle: The Gathering of the New Grain
readings.text: [Numbers 28:26] <dq>And on the day of the first-fruits, when you bring a new grain offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at your Festival of Shaḇuʽoth, you have a set-apart gathering, you do no servile work.</dq> [27] <dq>And you shall bring near an ascending offering as a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs a year old,</dq> [28] <dq>with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ěphah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,</dq> [29] <dq>one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [30] <dq>one male goat to make atonement for you,</dq> [31] <dq>perfect ones they are for you. Prepare them with their drink offerings, besides the continual ascending offering with its grain offering.</dq>

readings.title: Yom Teru'ah: The Awakening Blast
readings.subtitle: The Rehearsal of the Seventh Moon
readings.text: [Numbers 29:1] <dq>‘And in the seventh new moon, on the first day of the new moon, you have a set-apart gathering, you do no servile work, it is Yom Teru‛ah for you.</dq> [2] <dq>And you shall prepare an ascending offering as a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [3] <dq>and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ěphah for the bull, two-tenths for the ram,</dq> [4] <dq>and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [5] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,</dq> [6] <dq>besides the ascending offering with its grain offering for the New moon, the continual ascending offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their right-ruling, as a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: Yom Kippur: The Day of Covering
readings.subtitle: Afflicting the Soul for National Atonement
readings.text: [Numbers 29:7] <dq>And on the tenth day of this seventh new moon you have a set-apart gathering, and you shall afflict <dn>את</dn> your beings, you do no work.</dq> [8] <dq>And you shall bring near an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, a sweet fragrance: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs a year old, perfect ones they are for you,</dq> [9] <dq>and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ěphah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,</dq> [10] <dq>one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [11] <dq>one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement, the continual ascending offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: The Prophetic Rehearsal of Rest
readings.subtitle: Day One: The Foundational Thirteen Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:12] <dq>And on the fifteenth day of the seventh new moon you have a set-apart gathering, you do no servile work. And you shall celebrate a festival to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> seven days,</dq> [13] <dq>and you shall bring near an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones they are,</dq> [14] <dq>and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ěphah for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each of the two rams,</dq> [15] <dq>and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs,</dq> [16] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: Day Two
readings.subtitle: The Offering of Twelve Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:17] <dq>Then on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [18] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [19] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: Day Three
readings.subtitle: The Offering of Eleven Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:20] <dq>And on the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [21] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [22] <dq>and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: Day Four
readings.subtitle: The Offering of Ten Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:23] <dq>Then on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [24] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [25] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: Day Five
readings.subtitle: The Offering of Nine Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:26] <dq>Then on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [27] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [28] <dq>and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: Day Six
readings.subtitle: The Offering of Eight Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:29] <dq>Then on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [30] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [31] <dq>and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: Sukkot: Day Seven
readings.subtitle: The Offering of Seven Bulls
readings.text: [Numbers 29:32] <dq>Then on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [33] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [34] <dq>and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: The Eighth Day: The Infinite Cycle
readings.subtitle: The Culmination of the Appointed Times
readings.text: [Numbers 29:35] <dq>On the eighth day you have an assembly, you do no servile work,</dq> [36] <dq>and you shall bring near an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: one bull, one ram, seven lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [37] <dq>their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the right-ruling,</dq> [38] <dq>and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual ascending offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq>

readings.title: The Complete Architecture of Offerings
readings.subtitle: Moses Delivers the Divine Mandate
readings.text: [Numbers 29:39] <dq>These you prepare to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at your appointed times, besides your vowed offerings and your voluntary offerings, as your ascending offerings and your grain offerings, as your drink offerings and your peace offerings.’ ”</dq> [40] And Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ěl according to all <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
